methodology: Bounded preliminary textual screening; candidate passages are NOT primary-text-checked or verified. Compared prior PR #278 and open #93. No claims of exhaustive canonical ledger reconciliation or database inspection.

records.topic: Mountain raised over Israelites; covenant command
records.notes: Sinai mountain theophany and covenant have thematic overlap, but biblical accounts do not narrate the mountain being lifted over the people.
records.pending_question: Compare pre-Islamic Jewish interpretations of Sinai being suspended over Israel; establish dating of b. Shabbat 88a traditions versus redaction and witnesses.

records.topic: Descendants of Adam testify to God's lordship
records.notes: Intergenerational covenant and divine knowledge are broader motifs; no biblical passage here directly reproduces the Qur'anic primordial extraction of descendants and testimony.
records.pending_question: Investigate Jewish pre-existence and primordial covenant traditions with demonstrable pre-Islamic dating.

records.topic: Warning against claiming ancestors' idolatry as excuse
records.notes: Individual accountability contrasts with inherited blame, but Ezekiel does not narrate the primordial testimony in 7:172.
records.pending_question: Check exact context of inherited responsibility and avoid conflating theological principle with narrative parallel.

records.topic: Signs explained so people may return
records.notes: Repeated warning and repentance is a generic motif; no distinctive historical event or earlier textual narrative established.
records.pending_question: Revisit only upon discovery of distinctive earlier wording or independently dated tradition.

records.topic: Person given signs casts them aside and follows Satan
records.notes: Balaam is a possible later exegetical identification; the Qur'an does not name the individual, and Numbers does not reproduce this exact account of signs discarded.
records.pending_question: Check pre-Islamic Balaam reception (including Philo/Josephus) and distinguish later Muslim identifications from source-text evidence.
